text:
Why optprobe

Regular kprobes rely on breakpoint traps and are expensive when hit frequently.
Optprobes reduce this overhead by replacing breakpoints with direct jumps, making probes usable in hot paths.
This is important in practice because vendors such as OnePlus and projects like KernelSU make extensive use of kprobes, sometimes leaving them enabled long-term. Without optprobes, such usage would cause unacceptable performance overhead.
